dedupe_keys.name: global fractional urban changes at 1km under diverse ssp rcp scenarios throughout 2100

description: The global fractional urban-change research team publishes projected impervious-area fractions on a 1 km global grid under eight SSP-RCP combinations. The scenario series spans 2015–2100 at five-year intervals, accompanied by an urban-development suitability map and annual historical impervious-area maps for 1985–2015. Figshare supplies one ZIP per scenario containing GeoTIFFs, free under CC-BY-4.0. Fractions range from zero to one, not representing a binary urban label. The description says each scenario has 17 files, although inclusive five-year dates from 2015 to 2100 would imply 18; the archive listing was not inspected to resolve this discrepancy. These are conditional development scenarios, not forecasts of individual buildings. They could drive changing runoff coefficients, land demand or infrastructure exposure in long-term simulations. The dataset complements historical urban-extent products by providing spatially explicit future pathways with mixed urban fractions.
